key_terms.الْغُلَاةِ: The Ghulat, a sect known for exaggeration in the status of the Imams
key_terms.يُوسُفُ بْنُ بِهْمَانَ: Yusuf ibn Bahman, a specific narrator or figure

ai.seo_question: Who is Yusuf ibn Bahman and what does it mean that he is from the ghulat?
ai.summary: This brief biographical entry identifies Yusuf ibn Bahman as one of the 'ghulat' (exaggerators or high-ranking sectaries), a group known for attributing divine qualities to the Imams or elevating them beyond their human status.
